entry.name: mpeconfig
entry.digest: Configure a MIDI device that supports Multidimensional Polyphonic Expression (MPE) messages
entry.description: The mpeconfig object is used to set up and configure zones for interpreting incoming MIDI to MPE devices.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Themessage causes a zone to be defined based on the current settings ofand. You can have a maximum of 7 zones.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Themessage clears all currently configured zones and returns them to their default state.

messages.name: createzone
messages.description: The word, followed by a list of two integers that define the Master channel and the Note bend range, will define a zone. Nomessage is required when using this message. You can have a maximum of 7 zones configured in any way you wish amongst the 16 channels.

messages.name: masterbendrange
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer that specifies the maximum pitch bend range in semitones, will set the pitch bend range for all zones. that define the Master channel and the Note bend range, will define a zone. Nomessage is required when using this message.

messages.name: notebendrange
messages.digest: Set the note bend range for a master channel
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer that specifies the maximum pitch bend range in semitones, will set the pitch bend range for a specified master channel.If no master channel is set using aattribute, themessage must always be preceded by amessage to select a master channel, and followed by amessage to define the zone.

outlets.description: Out left outlet: MIDI messages are sent out as individual bytes.
Out right outlet: A formattedmessage for use with theobject.
